name: Turnover (BRSR Section A)
instruction: Turnover / revenue figure stated in BRSR Section A ('Paid-up capital', 'Turnover', 'Net worth' block). Copy the unit exactly (Rs., Rs. crore, Rs. lakh, INR million).

name: BRSR reporting boundary
instruction: Whether BRSR disclosures are made on a standalone or consolidated basis. Text: 'Standalone' or 'Consolidated'.

name: Total employees (permanent + other)
instruction: TOTAL EMPLOYEES row (D + E) of the 'Employees and workers (including differently abled)' table, column 'Total (A)'. Do NOT use workers.
keywords: employees and workers|total employees|permanent employees|other than permanent

name: Female employees (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-20(a) Employees, Total (D+E), Female No.
instruction: Number of FEMALE employees in the TOTAL EMPLOYEES (D+E) row. Use the 'No. (C)' count, not the %.

name: Male employees (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-20(a) Employees, Total (D+E), Male No.
instruction: Number of MALE employees in the TOTAL EMPLOYEES (D+E) row. Use the 'No. (B)' count, not the %.

name: Total workers (permanent + other)
instruction: TOTAL WORKERS row (F + G), column 'Total (A)'. If the company states it has no workers, return 0.
keywords: total workers|permanent workers|other than permanent workers

name: Female workers (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-20(b) Workers, Total (F+G), Female No.
instruction: Number of FEMALE workers in the TOTAL WORKERS (F+G) row.

name: Male workers (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-20(b) Workers, Total (F+G), Male No.
instruction: Number of MALE workers in the TOTAL WORKERS (F+G) row.

name: Board of Directors - total
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-21 Participation of women, Board of Directors, Total (A)
instruction: Total number of directors on the Board (row 'Board of Directors', column 'Total (A)').
keywords: participation/inclusion/representation of women|board of directors|key management personnel

name: Board of Directors - women
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-21 Board of Directors, No. of Females (B)
instruction: Number of women directors (row 'Board of Directors', column 'No. (B)' under Females).

name: Key Managerial Personnel - total
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-21 Key Management Personnel, Total (A)
instruction: Total number of KMPs (row 'Key Management Personnel', column 'Total (A)').

name: Key Managerial Personnel - women
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-21 Key Management Personnel, No. of Females (B)
instruction: Number of women KMPs.

name: Turnover rate - permanent employees (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-22 Permanent Employees, Total
instruction: Attrition/turnover rate of PERMANENT EMPLOYEES, 'Total' column, for each year shown.

name: Turnover rate - permanent workers (total)
brsr_reference: Section A, IV-22 Permanent Workers, Total
instruction: Attrition/turnover rate of PERMANENT WORKERS, 'Total' column.

name: Type of assurance obtained
brsr_reference: Section A, I-15/16 or BRSR Core assurance statement
instruction: Assurance level on BRSR / BRSR Core: 'Reasonable', 'Limited' or 'None', plus the assurance provider name.

name: Number of independent directors
brsr_reference: Annual report - Corporate Governance / Board composition
instruction: Number of Independent Directors on the Board at year end.

name: Number of board committees
brsr_reference: Annual report - Corporate Governance / Section B-9
instruction: Number of committees of the Board (Audit, Nomination & Remuneration, Stakeholders Relationship, CSR, Risk Management, ESG etc.). Count them.
keywords: committees of the board|audit committee|nomination and remuneration committee|stakeholders relationship committee|risk management committee

name: Names of board committees
instruction: List the names of the board committees, separated by semicolons.

name: Dedicated ESG / sustainability committee
instruction: Does the company have a specified Committee of the Board responsible for sustainability-related decisions? Answer 'Yes - <committee name>' or 'No'.
keywords: specified committee of the board|responsible for decision making on sustainability|esg committee|sustainability committee|csr and esg

name: Board meeting attendance
brsr_reference: Annual report - Corporate Governance / P1 EI
instruction: Average attendance of directors at Board meetings during the year, in %. Only if stated as a % (do not compute).

name: Sustainability report / framework
instruction: Has the company published a BRSR / sustainability / integrated report? 'Yes - <frameworks e.g. BRSR, GRI, IR, TCFD>' or 'No'.
keywords: sustainability report|integrated report|gri|business responsibility and sustainability report

name: Climate risk framework
instruction: Does the company disclose a climate-risk assessment framework (e.g. TCFD, climate scenario analysis)? 'Yes - <detail>' or 'No'.

name: Green bond / sustainable finance framework
instruction: Has the company issued green/sustainability-linked bonds or has a green finance framework? 'Yes - <detail>' or 'No'.

name: Net zero target
instruction: Net zero / carbon neutral target: 'Yes - target year <YYYY> - scope <Scope 1&2 / 1,2&3>' or 'No'.

name: International targets / commitments
instruction: International sustainability commitments/memberships e.g. SBTi, RE100, EP100, EV100, UNGC, CDP. List them.
keywords: sbti|science based targets|re100|ungc|united nations global compact|cdp|ev100|ep100

name: Social targets & commitments
instruction: Stated time-bound social targets (e.g. gender diversity %, living wage, safety targets, CSR reach). Short list.

name: Well-being spend as % of revenue
instruction: 'Spending on measures towards well-being of employees and workers (including permanent and other than permanent)' - cost incurred as % of total revenue of the company.
keywords: well-being of employees|wellbeing|cost incurred on well-being measures as a % of total revenue

name: LTIFR - employees
instruction: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (per one million person-hours worked) for EMPLOYEES.
keywords: lost time injury frequency rate|ltifr|per one million-person hours|safety related incidents

name: LTIFR - workers
instruction: Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (per one million person-hours worked) for WORKERS.

name: Fatalities - employees
instruction: Number of fatalities among EMPLOYEES. 'Nil' or '-' means 0.

name: Fatalities - workers
instruction: Number of fatalities among WORKERS. 'Nil' or '-' means 0.

name: Employees trained (%)
instruction: From 'Details of training given to employees and workers': % of TOTAL EMPLOYEES trained on skill upgradation (if only health & safety given, use that and say so in text).
keywords: details of training given to employees|skill upgradation|on health and safety measures

name: Median remuneration - female
instruction: Median remuneration/salary/wages of FEMALE employees (KMP excluded, use 'Employees other than BoD and KMP' row if available).

name: Median remuneration - male
instruction: Median remuneration/salary/wages of MALE employees (same row as female).

name: Ratio of highest paid to median remuneration
brsr_reference: Annual report - Directors' report Rule 5(1) / Section 197
instruction: Ratio of remuneration of the highest-paid director (usually MD/CEO) to the median remuneration of employees. Copy as a number (e.g. '245:1' -> 245).
keywords: ratio of the remuneration of each director to the median|median remuneration of employees|rule 5

name: POSH complaints filed
instruction: Sexual harassment complaints FILED during the year.

name: POSH complaints pending
instruction: Sexual harassment complaints PENDING resolution at the end of the year.

name: Total energy consumption
instruction: TOTAL energy consumption (renewable + non-renewable), row '(A+B+C+D+E+F)'. Copy unit (GJ / MJ / TJ / MWh).
keywords: total energy consumption|energy consumed|renewable sources|non-renewable sources|gigajoules

name: Energy from renewable sources
instruction: Total energy consumption from RENEWABLE sources (A+B+C).

name: Energy from non-renewable sources
instruction: Total energy consumption from NON-RENEWABLE sources (D+E+F).

name: Energy intensity (as reported)
brsr_reference: P6 EI-1 Energy intensity per rupee of turnover
instruction: Energy intensity per rupee of turnover as printed (keep the unit exactly e.g. 'GJ/Rs.'). Prefer the plain 'per rupee of turnover' row, not PPP.
keywords: energy intensity per rupee of turnover|energy intensity

name: Scope 1 emissions
instruction: Total Scope 1 emissions (CO2, CH4, N2O, HFCs, PFCs, SF6, NF3). Unit usually tCO2e.
keywords: scope 1|greenhouse gas emissions|tco2e|metric tonnes of co2 equivalent

name: Scope 2 emissions
instruction: Total Scope 2 emissions (location-based if both given; mention in text).

name: Scope 3 emissions
instruction: Total Scope 3 emissions.

name: Scope 1+2 intensity (as reported)
instruction: Total Scope 1 and Scope 2 emission intensity per rupee of turnover as printed (keep unit).
keywords: emission intensity per rupee of turnover|ghg intensity

name: SOx emissions
instruction: SOx emissions, value and unit exactly as printed (MT, tonnes, kg).

name: NOx emissions
instruction: NOx emissions, value and unit exactly as printed.

name: Total water consumption
brsr_reference: P6 EI-3 Total volume of water consumption
instruction: TOTAL volume of water CONSUMPTION (not withdrawal). Unit usually kilolitres.
keywords: water consumption|total volume of water|kilolitres|water withdrawal

name: Water recycled / reused
instruction: Volume of water recycled and/or reused.

name: Water intensity (as reported)
instruction: Water intensity per rupee of turnover as printed (keep unit).
keywords: water intensity per rupee of turnover|water intensity

name: Total waste generated
instruction: TOTAL waste generated (A+B+...+H). Unit usually metric tonnes.
keywords: total waste generated|waste management|metric tonnes|hazardous waste

name: Waste recovered (recycled+reused+other recovery)
instruction: TOTAL waste recovered through recycling, re-using or other recovery operations (the 'Total' of that block).

name: Waste intensity (as reported)
instruction: Waste intensity per rupee of turnover as printed (keep unit).
keywords: waste intensity per rupee of turnover|waste intensity

name: Green capex (% of capex)
instruction: Percentage of CAPEX investments in specific technologies to improve environmental and social impacts (Capex row, current and previous year).
keywords: percentage of r&d and capex|capex|r&d|improve the environmental and social impacts

name: CSR obligation / budget
brsr_reference: Annual report - Annual Report on CSR (2% obligation)
instruction: Total CSR obligation for the financial year (two percent of average net profit, plus/minus set-offs) - i.e. the budget. Copy unit (Rs. crore / lakh).
keywords: csr obligation|two percent of average net profit|total csr obligation|annual report on csr|prescribed csr expenditure

name: CSR amount spent
brsr_reference: Annual report - Annual Report on CSR
instruction: Total amount spent on CSR for the financial year (amount spent for the financial year, incl. admin overheads and impact assessment).
keywords: amount spent|total amount spent for the financial year|csr expenditure|corporate social responsibility

name: Wages paid in rural locations (%)
instruction: Job creation in smaller towns - wages paid to persons employed in RURAL locations as % of total wage cost.
keywords: job creation in smaller towns|rural|semi-urban|wage cost

name: Wages paid in semi-urban locations (%)
instruction: Wages paid to persons employed in SEMI-URBAN locations as % of total wage cost.

name: CSR spent in aspirational districts
instruction: Total amount spent on CSR projects in designated aspirational districts. Copy unit.

name: Consumer complaints received
instruction: Total consumer complaints received during the year (sum of all categories if only split given - say so in text).
keywords: consumer complaints|received during the year|pending resolution at end of year

name: Consumer complaints pending
instruction: Total consumer complaints pending resolution at end of year.

name: Revenue from operations - standalone
brsr_reference: Standalone Statement of Profit and Loss
instruction: Revenue from operations in the STANDALONE statement of profit and loss (or financial highlights). Copy unit (often 'Rs. in crore' / 'Rs. in lakhs' in table header).
keywords: revenue from operations|standalone statement of profit and loss|financial highlights|financial performance

name: Revenue from operations - consolidated
brsr_reference: Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss
instruction: Revenue from operations in the CONSOLIDATED statement of profit and loss.
keywords: revenue from operations|consolidated statement of profit and loss|consolidated

name: EBITDA
instruction: EBITDA (standalone unless only consolidated is given - say which in text).

name: Profit after tax
instruction: Profit for the year / Profit after tax (standalone unless only consolidated is given - say which in text).
keywords: profit for the year|profit after tax|pat|net profit

name: Total capex
instruction: Total capital expenditure for the year (e.g. 'Purchase of property, plant and equipment' in cash flow, or stated capex).
keywords: capital expenditure|capex|purchase of property, plant and equipment
